features.label: A clearer picture
features.heading: Less time assembling. More time understanding.
features.body: Which orders are making money? Where is the plan running out of room? Bring the records together, agree what the numbers mean and make the next question easier to answer.
benefits: Sales beside costs—not just a bigger headline number
Capacity beside demand—not another isolated spreadsheet
Definitions your team can inspect and understand

features.label: Work that keeps moving
features.heading: The next step shouldn’t depend on a good memory.
features.body: An enquiry arrives. A quote goes out. A reply changes the plan. Connect the steps with rules that know when to continue, when to stop and when someone needs to look.
benefits: Follow-ups that respond to what actually happened
Approvals attached to the right record
Exceptions visible to the person who can resolve them

features.label: A stronger first impression
features.heading: A website that makes the next conversation easier.
features.body: Make the offer clear. Give each service room to explain itself. Build a site that feels like your business, works comfortably on a phone and gives visitors a useful next step.
benefits: A message shaped around the customer’s question
Distinctive design with a purpose behind it
An enquiry journey checked from start to finish

playground.heading: What does a better working day look like?
playground.body: Change the plan. Follow the enquiry. Ask the question. Explore the small decisions a connected system can make easier.

tabs.label: A busy week
tabs.title: Another order comes in. Can the team cover it?
tabs.body: Move the weekly volume and change the people available. The workload updates from the handling time and staff hours, so you can see when the plan needs a different decision.
tabs.link: Planning tools built around your team

tabs.label: An unanswered quote
tabs.title: Follow up when it’s useful. Stop when the customer replies.
tabs.body: A reminder is only useful if it knows what happened since it was scheduled. Switch between a waiting quote and a received reply to see how the next action changes.

tabs.label: A customer question
tabs.eyebrow: A question with somewhere to go
tabs.title: Get the order update. Know when a person is needed.
tabs.body: A delivery question can use an authorised record. An address change needs more detail and a review. Try both—the source and the next step stay visible.

human.heading: Business understanding. Hands-on building. One point of contact.
human.body: I’m Karol Songin. My work brings together operations, data analysis and development—so we can talk about what’s happening in the business, not just what should happen on the screen.
human.second: From planning applications and Power BI reporting to workflows, websites and AI integration, the starting point stays the same: understand the job, then build the improvement that fits.
